parsed.post: Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6. Results show significant improvement: val_bpb 1.0542 -> 1.0231. The added model capacity seems to be yielding better compression. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH further to 8 or refining the learning rate to stabilize the larger model.
parsed.description: Increase DEPTH to 8 and slightly reduce MATRIX_LR to account for increased capacity and maintain stability.
